findingDetails.title: Shared package-root detection still depends on retired scripts sibling

findingDetails.recommendation: Use a current package-root landmark that exists in the shipped layout and add a test for the fallback path.

findingDetails.title: Stop-hook relative candidates need source/dist path regression coverage

findingDetails.scopeProof: Read the candidate resolver and its environment-mode guard.
